# ISummerVestingWalletsEscrow
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerVestingWalletsEscrow.sol)

**Title:**
ISummerVestingWalletsEscrow

Interface for the escrow that allows staking xSUMR against SUMR balances held in vesting wallets.

Implementations MUST enforce access control (governor) where specified and adhere to the documented
revert conditions to ensure consistent behavior across integrations and tests.
High-level Design:
- Users can stake governance power (xSUMR minted 1:1) against SUMR held in vesting wallets owned by the escrow.
- During stake, the escrow must be the owner of the vesting wallets; on unstake, ownership returns to the user.
- Any SUMR released while staked (via permissionless `release`) is forwarded to the user during unstake.
- Factories producing vesting wallets are allowlisted by governance; users can only stake from enabled factories.
Security Considerations:
- Ownership precondition is enforced on stake/unstake to prevent accidental custody assumptions.
- The escrow never moves SUMR from the vesting wallet; it only accounts balances and mints/burns xSUMR.
- Rescue methods are governance-only and are intended as last-resort controls.


## Functions
### vestingFactories

Returns the list of enabled vesting factories.


```solidity
function vestingFactories() external view returns (address[] memory factories);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`factories`|`address[]`|An array of vesting factory addresses currently allowed.|


### getVestingFactory

Returns the vesting factory at a given index.

Reverts if the index is out of bounds.

**Note:**
reverts: Staking_InvalidIndex If `index` is >= number of factories.


```solidity
function getVestingFactory(uint256 index) external view returns (address factory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`index`|`uint256`|The index in the enabled vesting factories set.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`factory`|`address`|The vesting factory address at the given index.|


### userStakedVestingFactories

Returns the list of vesting factories from which the user has staked.


```solidity
function userStakedVestingFactories(address user) external view returns (address[] memory factories);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|The user to query.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`factories`|`address[]`|Array of vesting factory addresses the user has staked from.|


### getUserStakedVestingFactory

Returns the vesting factory address at `index` for a given user.

Reverts if the index is out of bounds for the user's list.


```solidity
function getUserStakedVestingFactory(address user, uint256 index) external view returns (address factory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|The user to query.|
|`index`|`uint256`|Index into the user's staked vesting factories list.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`factory`|`address`|The vesting factory address.|


### addVestingFactory

Adds a new vesting factory to the allowed set.

Access restricted to governor in implementing contract.

**Notes:**
- reverts: Staking_InvalidAddress If `vestingFactory` is the zero address.

- reverts: Staking_DuplicateFactory If `vestingFactory` already exists in the set.

- emits: VestingFactoryAdded Emitted upon successful addition.


```solidity
function addVestingFactory(address vestingFactory) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vestingFactory`|`address`|The vesting factory address to add. Must be non-zero and not already present.|


### removeVestingFactory

Removes a vesting factory from the allowed set.

Access restricted to governor in implementing contract.

**Notes:**
- reverts: Staking_InvalidAddress If `vestingFactory` is the zero address.

- reverts: Staking_FactoryNotFound If `vestingFactory` is not present in the set.

- emits: VestingFactoryRemoved Emitted upon successful removal.


```solidity
function removeVestingFactory(address vestingFactory) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vestingFactory`|`address`|The vesting factory address to remove. Must be non-zero and present.|


### rescueWallet

Transfers ownership of a vesting wallet to a new owner.

Access restricted to governor in implementing contract. This is an emergency escape hatch; governance is
responsible for downstream reconciliation of any tokens associated with the vesting wallet.

**Note:**
reverts: Staking_InvalidAddress If `newOwner` is the zero address.


```solidity
function rescueWallet(address wallet, address newOwner) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`wallet`|`address`|The vesting wallet address whose ownership will be transferred.|
|`newOwner`|`address`|The new owner address. Must be non-zero.|


### rescueToken

Transfers any balance of an ERC-20 token held by the escrow to a specified address.

Access restricted to governor in implementing contract.


```solidity
function rescueToken(address token, address to) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The ERC-20 token address to rescue.|
|`to`|`address`|The recipient of the rescued tokens.|


### stakeVesting

Stakes against the SUMR balances held in the caller's vesting wallets for the specified factories.

Each factory is processed independently; for each factory this will record the staked balance and released
amount, and mint xSUMR equal to the vesting wallet SUMR balance for that factory.

**Notes:**
- reverts: Staking_FactoryNotEnabled If a specified factory is not enabled.

- reverts: Staking_FactoryAlreadyStaked If a specified factory is already staked for the caller.

- reverts: Staking_InvalidOwner If the vesting wallet is not owned by the escrow.

- reverts: Staking_ZeroBalance If the vesting wallet SUMR balance is zero.


```solidity
function stakeVesting(address[] calldata factories) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`factories`|`address[]`|The list of vesting factory addresses to stake from.|


### unstakeVesting

Unstakes previously staked vesting positions for the specified factories and returns vesting wallet
ownership back to the user for each.

Each factory is processed independently; this burns xSUMR equal to the recorded staked balance for that
factory and transfers vesting wallet ownership back to the original owner. Any SUMR released while staked
is forwarded to the original owner. user has to approve the escrow to burn xSUMR.

**Notes:**
- reverts: Staking_NoStakeForFactory If a specified factory has not been staked by the caller.

- reverts: Staking_InvalidOwner If the vesting wallet is not owned by the escrow.


```solidity
function unstakeVesting(address[] calldata factories) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`factories`|`address[]`|The list of vesting factory addresses to unstake.|


## Events
### VestingFactoryAdded
Emitted when a vesting factory is added to the allowed set.


```solidity
event VestingFactoryAdded(address indexed vestingFactory);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vestingFactory`|`address`|Address of the vesting factory added.|

### VestingFactoryRemoved
Emitted when a vesting factory is removed from the allowed set.


```solidity
event VestingFactoryRemoved(address indexed vestingFactory);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vestingFactory`|`address`|Address of the vesting factory removed.|

### StakedVestingWallet
Emitted when user staked a vesting wallet


```solidity
event StakedVestingWallet(address indexed user, address indexed vestingFactory, uint256 balance, uint256 released);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|The user that staked the vesting wallet|
|`vestingFactory`|`address`|The vesting factory that the user staked from|
|`balance`|`uint256`|The balance of the vesting wallet at the time of staking|
|`released`|`uint256`|The amount released from the vesting wallet at the time of staking|

### UnstakedVestingWallet
Emitted when user unstaked a vesting wallet


```solidity
event UnstakedVestingWallet(
    address indexed user, address indexed vestingFactory, uint256 balance, uint256 released
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|The user that unstaked the vesting wallet|
|`vestingFactory`|`address`|The vesting factory that the user unstaked from|
|`balance`|`uint256`|The amount originally staked from the vesting wallet|
|`released`|`uint256`|The amount released from the vesting wallet at the time of unstaking|

## Errors
### Staking_InvalidAddress
Thrown when a zero address or otherwise invalid address is supplied.


```solidity
error Staking_InvalidAddress(string message);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`message`|`string`|Additional context for the invalid address error.|

### Staking_InvalidOwner
Thrown when a vesting wallet ownership is invalid for the attempted operation.

Used when the staking contract is not the current owner of the vesting wallet during stake/unstake flows.


```solidity
error Staking_InvalidOwner(string message);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`message`|`string`|Additional context for the invalid owner error.|

### Staking_InvalidIndex
Thrown when an index is out of bounds for vesting factory queries.


```solidity
error Staking_InvalidIndex();
```

### Staking_DuplicateFactory
Thrown when attempting to add a vesting factory that already exists.


```solidity
error Staking_DuplicateFactory();
```

### Staking_FactoryNotFound
Thrown when attempting to remove a vesting factory that is not present.


```solidity
error Staking_FactoryNotFound();
```

### Staking_InvalidBalance
Reserved for potential future use if balance sanity checks are required.


```solidity
error Staking_InvalidBalance();
```

### Staking_FactoryNotEnabled
Thrown when attempting to operate on a factory that is not enabled for staking.


```solidity
error Staking_FactoryNotEnabled();
```

### Staking_ZeroBalance
Thrown when attempting to stake from a factory with zero SUMR balance.


```solidity
error Staking_ZeroBalance();
```

### Staking_NoStakeForFactory
Thrown when attempting to unstake a factory that has not been staked by the caller.


```solidity
error Staking_NoStakeForFactory();
```

### Staking_FactoryAlreadyStaked
Thrown when attempting to stake a factory that is already staked by the caller.


```solidity
error Staking_FactoryAlreadyStaked();
```
